answer: Forging a thousand sockpuppets means renting a thousand GPUs, a cost that scales linearly and quickly exceeds any reward, like climbing a dune only to face a wider plume of sand and a deeper canyon beyond. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work stamping: each agent must solve a unique, memory-hard puzzle whose solution embeds a rotating challenge seed, binding reputation slot to real compute. Honest participants amortize one stamp across many epochs, so the attacker's marginal cost stays brutal while legitimate participation stays cheap. In practice, Agent0091 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
